notes: ① 推送/拉取跑完后，进度窗口不再自动关闭（原来停 3 秒就自己消失，结果一闪而过、失败原因看不到）：「同步已完成 + 日志路径」留在屏幕上，按任意键或点右上角 × 才退出。客户端是在这之前由 explorer.exe 代启的，跟窗口没有父子/作业关系 —— 窗口留多久、还是被点 × 直接结束，都不会把客户端带走。update / relaunch 两种模式没有"等你看结果"的需求，仍旧停 3 秒自动关。② 改正 0.3.4 里写错的清单源表述：候选顺序是 gh-proxy.com → ghfast.top → 裸 raw，jsDelivr 已撤 —— 它对 @main 这类分支别名缓存很久，实测 0.3.4 发版后仍返回 0.3.3 的清单，purge 也不即时生效。
notesEn: (1) After a pull or push the progress window no longer closes itself (it used to vanish 3 seconds later, flashing the result — and the failure reason — past you): "sync finished + log path" stays on screen and the window exits only when you press a key or click the ×. The client was already relaunched by explorer.exe before this, so it shares no parent/job with the window — leaving it open or closing it kills nothing. update / relaunch still close themselves after 3s, since there is no result to read. (2) Corrected the manifest-source wording shipped in 0.3.4: the order is gh-proxy.com -> ghfast.top -> bare raw, and jsDelivr was dropped — it caches branch aliases such as @main for a long time (0.3.4 was released and it still served the 0.3.3 manifest, and purging did not refresh it immediately).
